rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for an independent examination of financial records, controls, and procedures.

example.english: The company hired outside accountants to conduct an audit this year to make sure the accounts were in order.
example.traditional: 公司今年請外間會計師做審計，確保賬目冇問題。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 ceng2 ngoi6 gaan1 wui6 gai3 si1 zou6 sam2 gai3 kok3 bou2 zoeng3 muk6 mou5 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this as the everyday Hong Kong term for auditing financial accounts.

example.english: The company has to audit every year to make sure the accounts are fine.
example.traditional: 公司每年都要核數，確保啲賬目冇問題。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 mui5 nin4 dou1 jiu3 wat6 sou3 kok3 bou2 di1 zoeng3 muk6 mou5 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this for a formal, independent audit of records, systems, or compliance procedures rather than ordinary account-checking.

example.english: External consultants audit the company’s information-security system to ensure it complies with regulations.
example.traditional: 外聘顧問會審計公司嘅資訊保安系統，確保符合規定。
example.jyutping: ngoi6 ping3 gu3 man6 wui5 sam2 gai3 gung1 si1 ge3 zi1 seon3 bou2 on1 hai6 tung2 kok3 bou2 fu4 hap6 kwai1 ding6
